plotSections.title: Regrouping at the Stronghold
bullets: The party regroups at Langdale Stronghold over dinner as planned. Walker yells for Ord by his full name, Ord Tholomew Bronze Tan, and Ord makes his way to the kitchen.

Mahali (also called Moradin) cooks dinner. He asks Walker to fetch his roommate to help dice vegetables, then teases the party for yelling when they have a magic communication stone. Gerk argues the family should not rely on magic so much.
Mahali gives Gerk a Macintosh apple. Gerk says he does not like apples and shares his knowledge of apple grafting.

plotSections.title: Mahali's Godhood
bullets: Mahali describes himself as a small deity. He says becoming a god was not a conscious choice: first a few believed in him, then more, then many, and that is when he claimed his domain.
His domain is hearth, home, and craftsmanship, depending on his current followers. He does not fight over the dead the way other gods do.
He explains that a god needs followers who truly believe, calling it a weird loophole of the universe and a technicality. He says gods love technicalities more than anyone.
He begins to explain the Weave to Walker, who says he was never taught it.

plotSections.title: Moxie
bullets: Mahali reveals a new 'roommate' named Moxie. The hot tub plan in the roommates' quarters failed because poor ventilation let steam warp the bunk beds, and Moxie was found afterward.
Moxie looks like a wolverine mixed with a beaver. It eats anything, nibbles fingers a little, and almost talks, which is why it counts as a roommate rather than a pet.
Ord takes a scrap bucket downstairs to feed Moxie.

chronologicalEvents: Walker calls Ord to the kitchen using his full name, Ord Tholomew Bronze Tan.
